title: WNT Signaling Modifies Barrier Functions of Junctional and Pocket Epithelium
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
The aims of this study were 1) to determine how ligature-induced periodontitis (LIP) disrupts barrier functions of the junctional epithelium (JE); 2) to determine, using a genetic approach, the necessity of Wnt signaling for JE barrier functions; and 3) ...
